title: Bestway FlowClear AquaDrift Automatic Pool Vacuum (58665E)

comparisons.notes: Model 58665E-BW, same Bestway FlowClear AquaDrift automatic above-ground pool vacuum in blue, same specs (pools up to 22 ft, 1,500-3,200 gal/h pumps). Price shown, no out-of-stock notice.

writeup: Woot's clearance sale has the Bestway FlowClear AquaDrift automatic pool vacuum (model 58665E) for $29.99, while The Home Depot charges $107.99 for the same model. It runs off your existing filter pump and is built for above-ground pools up to 22 feet. Woot's sale notes say units ship open box, so expect possibly rough packaging, and stock is down to the last unit.
